title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Tuesday, 15 September 2026
description: Today: Microsoft publishes a new AI Code of Conduct as tech-industry layoffs pass 210,000 for the year; Canberra presses ahead with a private health rebate cut for over-65s and Pauline Hanson offers a qualified apology; Queensland searches for a missing Biloela girl while the town's hospital regains birthing services; and the Gold Coast's Marine Quarter breaks ground as Suns forward Ben King eyes free agency. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
